mentions.name: AI infrastructure for e-commerce operations
mentions.description: This system is AI infrastructure for a small e-commerce business with a dozen team members that manages a couple dozen brands and sells on Amazon. It provides task tracking, project management, and a centralized customer knowledge database for running account-specific strategies.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building AI infra for my small ecom businesss (a dozen team members; we manage a couple dozen brands and sell on Amazon etc.) so we can do task tracking, project management, and have a centralized customer knowledge database when we need to run account-specific strats and what not.
mentions.author: binarysolo
